title: Master Engineering Directive: Pure-Codebase Forensic Audit & Zero-Gap Remediation
spec:
# SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE
Execute roo-directives/MASTER_ENGINEERING_DIRECTIVE.md. The developer MUST read roo-directives/MASTER_ENGINEERING_DIRECTIVE.md in full, use the roo-directives/ directory as the single source of truth to create and track sub-directives, establish a fresh pure-codebase baseline (zero historical assumptions), run diagnostics, identify pre-existing errors/warnings, audit frozen modules, and achieve a demonstrable 99-100% code quality standard.

# SECTION 2 — PLAN MODE VS ACT MODE
Current authorization: PLAN MODE. Developer must perform read-only forensic discovery and baseline measurement. Zero application code modifications are permitted until Antigravity evaluates and approves the baseline audit plan.

# SECTION 3 — PRE-FLIGHT REPOSITORY VERIFICATION
Verify repository at D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365. Record git status, branch, HEAD commit SHA, dependencies, and active background services.

# SECTION 4 — PROJECT INVARIANTS REGISTER
Preserve certified baseline invariants: Firebase Auth tokens, NVIDIA/OpenRouter router contracts, dual-database sync integrity, and frozen module boundaries.

# SECTION 9 — TEST STRATEGY & ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Execute full diagnostics: ESLint, TypeScript/builds, unit tests, integration tests, and Playwright DOM crawls. Zero unresolved actionable errors or warnings.

# SECTION 11 — SEVERITY & WAVE SEQUENCING
Wave 1 (Phase A): Security & Data Integrity. Wave 2 (Phase B): Pre-existing diagnostics & workflow repairs. Wave 3 (Phase C): UI/UX & Responsive audit. Wave 4 (Phase D-F): Verification & Certification.

# SECTION 13 — BRIDGE SUBMISSION SYNTAX
Developer must submit baseline plan via:
node C:\Users\mbhas\.ai-bridge\bridge.cjs dev plan --directive <DIR_ID> --summary "Pure codebase baseline audit plan" --steps "s1;s2"
followed by:
node C:\Users\mbhas\.ai-bridge\bridge.cjs dev wake-lead --directive <DIR_ID> --reason "Baseline audit plan submitted"
